title: चतुस्त्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Karna drives Yudhishthira from the field and spares him at Kunti's request, and Bhima furiously attacks Karna's army with iron arrows. Bhima defeats Karna and scatters the Dhartarashtra army.
summary.kn: ಕರ್ಣ ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನನ್ನು ರಣರಂಗದಿಂದ ಓಡಿಸಿ ಕುಂತಿಯ ಕೋರಿಕೆಯಂತೆ ಬಿಡುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಭೀಮ ಕೋಪದಿಂದ ಕಬ್ಬಿಣದ ಬಾಣಗಳಿಂದ ಕರ್ಣನ ಸೈನ್ಯದ ಮೇಲೆ ಎರಗುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಭೀಮ ಕರ್ಣನನ್ನು ಸೋಲಿಸಿ ಧಾರ್ತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರ ಸೈನ್ಯವನ್ನು ಚದುರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: कर्ण युधिष्ठिर को रणभूमि से भगाता है और कुन्ती को दिए वचन से उन्हें छोड़ देता है, और भीम क्रोध से लोहे के बाणों से कर्ण की सेना पर टूटते हैं। भीम कर्ण को हराकर धार्तराष्ट्र सेना को बिखेर देते हैं।
summary.te: కర్ణుడు యుధిష్ఠిరుని రణభూమి నుండి తరిమి కుంతి కోరికపై వదిలేస్తాడు; భీముడు కోపంతో ఇనుప బాణాలతో కర్ణుని సేనపై దాడి చేస్తాడు. భీముడు కర్ణుని ఓడించి ధార్తరాష్ట్ర సేనను చెదరగొడతాడు.
summary.ta: கர்ணன் யுதிஷ்டிரரைக் களத்திலிருந்து விரட்டிக் குந்திக்கு அளித்த வாக்கின்படி அவரை விடுகிறான்; பீமன் சினத்துடன் இரும்பு அம்புகளால் கர்ணனின் படையைத் தாக்குகிறான். பீமன் கர்ணனை வென்று திருதராஷ்டிரப் படையைச் சிதறடிக்கிறான்.
summary.ml: കർണ്ണൻ യുധിഷ്ഠിരനെ യുദ്ധക്കളത്തിൽനിന്ന് ഓടിക്കുന്നു; കുന്തിയുടെ അപേക്ഷപ്രകാരം അദ്ദേഹത്തെ വധിക്കാതെ വിടുന്നു. കോപാകുലനായ ഭീമൻ ഇരുമ്പമ്പുകൾകൊണ്ട് കർണ്ണന്റെ സേനയെ ആക്രമിക്കുന്നു. ഭീമൻ കർണ്ണനെ തോൽപ്പിച്ച്, ധാർത്തരാഷ്ട്ര സേനയെ ചിതറിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 8.34; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Jul 29 2019

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
तानभिद्रवतो दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवांस्तावकं बलम् ।
क्रोशतस्तव पुत्रस्य न स्म राजन्न्यवर्तत ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the Pandavas rushing on, your army, though your son called out, king, did not turn back.

verses.text:
ततः पक्षात्प्रपक्षाच्च प्रपक्षैश्चापि दक्षिणात् ।
उदस्तशस्त्राः कुरवो भीममभ्यद्रवन्रणे ॥

meaning.en: Then from the wings, flanks and right side, the Kurus with weapons raised rushed at Bhima in the battle.

verses.text:
कर्णोऽपि दृष्ट्वा द्रवतो धार्तराष्ट्रान्पराङ्मुखान् ।
हंसवर्णान्हयाग्र्यांस्तान्प्रैषीद्यत्र वृकोदरम् ॥

meaning.en: Karna, seeing the Dhartarashtras fleeing with their backs turned, sent his swan-white excellent horses to where Vrikodara was.

verses.text:
ते प्रेषिता महाराज शल्येनाहवशोभिना ।
भीमसेनरथं प्राप्य समसज्जन्त वाजिनः ॥

meaning.en: Driven, great king, by Shalya, who graced the battle, those horses reached Bhimasena's chariot and engaged.

verses.text:
दृष्ट्वा कर्णं समायान्तं भीमः क्रोधसमन्वितः ।
मतिं दध्रे विनाशाय कर्णस्य भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Karna come on, Bhima, filled with anger, resolved on Karna's destruction, bull of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
सोऽब्रवीत्सात्यकिं वीरं धृष्टद्युम्नं च पार्षतम् ।
एनं रक्षत राजानं धर्मात्मानं युधिष्ठिरम् ।
संशयान्महतो मुक्तं कथंचित्प्रेक्षतो मम ॥

meaning.en: He said to the hero Satyaki and to Prishata's son Dhrishtadyumna: "Guard this king, the dharma-souled Yudhishthira, who has somehow escaped great danger before my eyes."

verses.text:
अग्रतो मे कृतो राजा छिन्नसर्वपरिच्छदः ।
दुर्योधनस्य प्रीत्यर्थं राधेयेन दुरात्मना ॥

meaning.en: "The king was set before me, stripped of all his gear, by the evil-souled Radheya, to please Duryodhana."

verses.text:
अन्तमद्य करिष्यामि तस्य दुःखस्य पार्षत ।
हन्ता वास्मि रणे कर्णं स वा मां निहनिष्यति ।
संग्रामेण सुघोरेण सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीमि वः ॥

meaning.en: "Today, son of Prishata, I will end that sorrow: either I will kill Karna in battle or he will kill me in this most dreadful fight. I tell you this truly."

verses.text:
राजानमद्य भवतां न्यासभूतं ददामि वै ।
अस्य संरक्षणे सर्वे यतध्वं विगतज्वराः ॥

meaning.en: "Today I give the king to you as a trust; all of you strive without anxiety to protect him."

verses.text:
एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहुः प्रायादाधिरथिं प्रति ।
सिंहनादेन महता सर्वाः संनादयन्दिशः ॥

meaning.en: Having said this, the long-armed one went toward Adhiratha's son, making all the directions resound with a great lion-roar.

verses.text:
दृष्ट्वा त्वरितमायान्तं भीमं युद्धाभिनन्दिनम् ।
सूतपुत्रमथोवाच मद्राणामीश्वरो विभुः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Bhima, who delighted in battle, coming quickly, the mighty lord of the Madras spoke to the charioteer's son.

verses.text:
पश्य कर्ण महाबाहुं क्रुद्धं पाण्डवनन्दनम् ।
दीर्घकालार्जितं क्रोधं मोक्तुकामं त्वयि ध्रुवम् ॥

meaning.en: "Look, Karna, at the long-armed delight of the Pandavas, angry, surely wishing to loose on you the rage stored up over a long time."

verses.text:
ईदृशं नास्य रूपं मे दृष्टपूर्वं कदाचन ।
अभिमन्यौ हते कर्ण राक्षसे वा घटोत्कचे ॥

meaning.en: "I have never seen him look like this before, Karna, not when Abhimanyu was killed, nor when the rakshasa Ghatotkacha was."

verses.text:
त्रैलोक्यस्य समस्तस्य शक्तः क्रुद्धो निवारणे ।
बिभर्ति यादृशं रूपं कालाग्निसदृशं शुभम् ॥

meaning.en: "In anger he could hold back the whole of the three worlds, such is the beautiful form he bears, like the fire at the world's end."

verses.text:
इति ब्रुवति राधेयं मद्राणामीश्वरे नृप ।
अभ्यवर्तत वै कर्णं क्रोधदीप्तो वृकोदरः ॥

meaning.en: While the lord of the Madras was saying this to Radheya, king, Vrikodara, blazing with anger, advanced on Karna.

verses.text:
तथागतं तु संप्रेक्ष्य भीमं युद्धाभिनन्दिनम् ।
अब्रवीद्वचनं शल्यं राधेयः प्रहसन्निव ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Bhima, who delighted in battle, come like that, Radheya, as if laughing, said to Shalya:

verses.text:
यदुक्तं वचनं मेऽद्य त्वया मद्रजनेश्वर ।
भीमसेनं प्रति विभो तत्सत्यं नात्र संशयः ॥

meaning.en: "What you said today, lord of the Madras, about Bhimasena is true, there is no doubt of it."

verses.text:
एष शूरश्च वीरश्च क्रोधनश्च वृकोदरः ।
निरपेक्षः शरीरे च प्राणतश्च बलाधिकः ॥

meaning.en: "This Vrikodara is brave, heroic and irascible, careless of his body and of life, and exceedingly strong."

verses.text:
अज्ञातवासं वसता विराटनगरे तदा ।
द्रौपद्याः प्रियकामेन केवलं बाहुसंश्रयात् ।
गूढभावं समाश्रित्य कीचकः सगणो हतः ॥

meaning.en: "When he lived in disguise in Virata's city, wishing only to please Draupadi, relying only on his arms and keeping his identity hidden, he killed Kichaka with his followers."

verses.text:
सोऽद्य संग्रामशिरसि संनद्धः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः ।
किंकरोद्यतदण्डेन मृत्युनापि व्रजेद्रणम् ॥

meaning.en: "Today, armored at the head of the battle, swooning with rage, he would go to the fight even with Death who held his rod raised."

verses.text:
चिरकालाभिलषितो ममायं तु मनोरथः ।
अर्जुनं समरे हन्यां मां वा हन्याद्धनंजयः ।
स मे कदाचिदद्यैव भवेद्भीमसमागमात् ॥

meaning.en: "But this wish of mine has been long desired: to kill Arjuna in battle, or have Dhananjaya kill me. Perhaps today it could come about from this meeting with Bhima."

verses.text:
निहते भीमसेने तु यदि वा विरथीकृते ।
अभियास्यति मां पार्थस्तन्मे साधु भविष्यति ।
अत्र यन्मन्यसे प्राप्तं तच्छीघ्रं संप्रधारय ॥

meaning.en: "If Bhimasena is killed or made chariotless and Partha then comes against me, that will be good for me. Decide quickly what you think fitting in this."

verses.text:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनं राधेयस्य महात्मनः ।
उवाच वचनं शल्यः सूतपुत्रं तथागतम् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing the words of the great-souled Radheya, Shalya spoke to the charioteer's son, who had come to this.

verses.text:
अभियासि महाबाहो भीमसेनं महाबलम् ।
निरस्य भीमसेनं तु ततः प्राप्स्यसि फल्गुनम् ॥

meaning.en: "You are going against the mighty Bhimasena, long-armed one; after you throw Bhimasena aside, you will reach Phalguna."

verses.text:
यस्ते कामोऽभिलषितश्चिरात्प्रभृति हृद्गतः ।
स वै संपत्स्यते कर्ण सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीमि ते ॥

meaning.en: "What you have long desired and kept in your heart will be fulfilled, Karna; I tell you truly."

verses.text:
एवमुक्ते ततः कर्णः शल्यं पुनरभाषत ।
हन्ताहमर्जुनं संख्ये मां वा हन्ता धनंजयः ।
युद्धे मनः समाधाय याहि याहीत्यचोदयत् ॥

meaning.en: When he said this, Karna answered Shalya again: "I will kill Arjuna in battle, or Dhananjaya will kill me." With his mind set on the fight, he urged him: "Go, go!"

verses.text:
ततः प्रायाद्रथेनाशु शल्यस्तत्र विशां पते ।
यत्र भीमो महेष्वासो व्यद्रावयत वाहिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Shalya swiftly drove the chariot, lord of the people, to where the great bowman Bhima was scattering the army.

verses.text:
ततस्तूर्यनिनादश्च भेरीणां च महास्वनः ।
उदतिष्ठत राजेन्द्र कर्णभीमसमागमे ॥

meaning.en: Then a sound of trumpets and the great din of kettledrums arose, king of kings, at the meeting of Karna and Bhima.

verses.text:
भीमसेनोऽथ संक्रुद्धस्तव सैन्यं दुरासदम् ।
नाराचैर्विमलैस्तीक्ष्णैर्दिशः प्राद्रावयद्बली ॥

meaning.en: Bhimasena, enraged, mighty, drove your hard-to-approach army in all directions with bright, sharp iron arrows.

verses.text:
स संनिपातस्तुमुलो भीमरूपो विशां पते ।
आसीद्रौद्रो महाराज कर्णपाण्डवयोर्मृधे ।
ततो मुहूर्ताद्राजेन्द्र पाण्डवः कर्णमाद्रवत् ॥

meaning.en: That clash of Karna and the Pandava in the battle was tumultuous, fearsome and terrible, lord of the people. Then, after a moment, king, the Pandava rushed at Karna.

verses.text:
तमापतन्तं संप्रेक्ष्य कर्णो वैकर्तनो वृषः ।
आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धो नाराचेन स्तनान्तरे ।
पुनश्चैनममेयात्मा शरवर्षैरवाकिरत् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing him rush on, Karna Vaikartana, the Vrisha, angrily struck him in the chest between the breasts with an iron arrow, and the immeasurable one covered him again with showers of arrows.

verses.text:
स विद्धः सूतपुत्रेण छादयामास पत्रिभिः ।
विव्याध निशितैः कर्ण नवभिर्नतपर्वभिः ॥

meaning.en: Pierced by the charioteer's son, he covered Karna with arrows and pierced him with nine sharp bent-jointed ones.

verses.text:
तस्य कर्णो धनुर्मध्ये द्विधा चिच्छेद पत्रिणा ।
अथ तं छिन्नधन्वानमभ्यविध्यत्स्तनान्तरे ।
नाराचेन सुतीक्ष्णेन सर्वावरणभेदिना ॥

meaning.en: Karna cut Bhima's bow in the middle in two with an arrow, and then pierced him, his bow cut, between the breasts with a very sharp iron arrow that splits all armor.

verses.text:
सोऽन्यत्कार्मुकमादाय सूतपुत्रं वृकोदरः ।
राजन्मर्मसु मर्मज्ञो विद्ध्वा सुनिशितैः शरैः ।
ननाद बलवन्नादं कम्पयन्निव रोदसी ॥

meaning.en: Vrikodara, knowing vital spots, took another bow and pierced the charioteer's son in his vitals with very sharp arrows, king, and gave a mighty roar as if shaking heaven and earth.

verses.text:
तं कर्णः पञ्चविंशत्या नाराचानां समार्दयत् ।
मदोत्कटं वने दृप्तमुल्काभिरिव कुञ्जरम् ॥

meaning.en: Karna harassed him with twenty-five iron arrows, like a rutting, proud elephant in a forest with firebrands.

verses.text:
ततः सायकभिन्नाङ्गः पाण्डवः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः ।
संरम्भामर्षताम्राक्षः सूतपुत्रवधेच्छया ॥

meaning.en: Then the Pandava, his limbs torn by arrows, swooning with anger, eyes red with fury and impatience, wanted to kill the charioteer's son.

verses.text:
स कार्मुके महावेगं भारसाधनमुत्तमम् ।
गिरीणामपि भेत्तारं सायकं समयोजयत् ॥

meaning.en: He fitted to his bow an arrow of great speed, a very strong one able to bear great force, one that could split even mountains.

verses.text:
विकृष्य बलवच्चापमा कर्णादतिमारुतिः ।
तं मुमोच महेष्वासः क्रुद्धः कर्णजिघांसया ॥

meaning.en: The son of the wind, drawing the strong bow back to his ear, angry, wanting to kill Karna, released it, that great bowman.

verses.text:
स विसृष्टो बलवता बाणो वज्राशनिस्वनः ।
अदारयद्रणे कर्णं वज्रवेग इवाचलम् ॥

meaning.en: That arrow loosed by the mighty man, with a sound like thunderbolt and lightning, split Karna in the battle as a thunderbolt splits a mountain.

verses.text:
स भीमसेनाभिहतो सूतपुत्रः कुरूद्वह ।
निषसाद रथोपस्थे विसंज्ञः पृतनापतिः ॥

meaning.en: Struck by Bhimasena, the charioteer's son, bearer of the Kurus' burden and leader of the army, sank down senseless on his chariot's seat.

verses.text:
ततो मद्राधिपो दृष्ट्वा विसंज्ञं सूतनन्दनम् ।
अपोवाह रथेनाजौ कर्णमाहवशोभिनम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the charioteer's son senseless, the lord of the Madras carried Karna, who graced the battle, away from the field in the chariot.

verses.text:
ततः पराजिते कर्णे धार्तराष्ट्रीं महाचमूम् ।
व्यद्रावयद्भीमसेनो यथेन्द्रो दानवीं चमूम् ॥

meaning.en: Then, with Karna defeated, Bhimasena routed the great Dhartarashtra army as Indra routs the Danava host.
